(Currently amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting a unique identifier for database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1, wherein inputting further includes inputting the database constructs as query execution plans for a specific query.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 2, wherein inputting further includes identifying at least one database construct as a least cost query execution plan identified from the query execution plans by the database optimizer specifically based on execution metrics.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3, wherein identifying further includes identifying individual pieces of the least cost query execution plan as: a total number of spools used, cardinality for tables with any intermediate results used, a total number of merge joins, a total number of hash joins, nested loop joins, references for the spools, and costs per database resource assigned by the database optimizer.

(Currently amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Processing Unit (CPU) execution time for one or more Access Module Processors to execute when processing the database operation based on historical analysis.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations performed by one or more Access Module Processors during execution when processing the database operation using recent performance data.

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs for future reference to monitor optimization.

(Currently amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a specific query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan specifically identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the specific query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the specific query, a scheduled execution time for the specific query, and resources that are used to execute the specific query based on the predicted execution time. 

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and current performance metrics associated with the execution resource. 

(Currently amended) Claim 19: A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predictive value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system. 

(Currently amended) Claim 20: The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a specific query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the specific query within the database management system.
